verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Ari is operated through natural-language chat across many tasks. You can ask affordability and cash-runway questions, request scenarios 'in one line', trigger or stop syncs and add tables 'by asking Ari', and have Ari rebuild a workbook as a live Model. External agents such as Claude Code and Codex can also drive the Model conversationally via MCP, including handing questions to Ari through edit_chats. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably as described.
